source.name: Natural Earth 1:50m Shaded Relief Basic (SR_50M)
source.description: Land shaded relief derived from downsampled SRTM Plus elevation data, clipped to the 1:50m coastline.
source.licenseSummary: Natural Earth permits use, modification, and electronic redistribution for personal, educational, and commercial purposes; no permission or attribution is required.

projection.name: Spherical Albers equal-area, matching the existing D3 map

processing.resampling: Bilinear inverse projection, sampling each output pixel center
processing.outsideOutline: White outside the existing main outline, with one output pixel of padding; the SVG retains final clipping control.
processing.display: Place over city fills as multiply-blended SVG image at x=0 y=0 width=1000 height=851, clip to the main outline, and keep borders and labels above it.
processing.limitations: Static shaded-relief texture, not elevation geometry. The South China Sea inset has its own schematic coordinates and is not covered by this layer. Natural Earth's 1:50m coastline is generalized; the application's existing boundary clip controls the displayed outline.
